title: DSSD 2026 Corporate Sponsorship Packet
description: Data Science For Sustainable Development (DSSD) at UW-Madison is a 120-member student organization that builds pro-bono data-science solutions for nonprofits and runs a spring Datathon drawing 300+ students. Sponsorship funds project compute, our speaker series, and the Datathon, and gives partners direct access to a pipeline of analytics, statistics, and engineering talent through branded workshops, resume books, and recruiting sessions.
